snippet.title: Hell Architect: Survivors - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
#Hell #Roguelite #Survivors 

“Hell’s never looked this good.” – Lucifer, probably. 

Hell Architect: Survivors is a darkly ironic action roguelite set in Dante’s Hell, where sin isn’t a punishment… it’s power.

Play as a demon architect with a rebellious streak and a few questionable design choices, like overthrowing Lucifer himself.

- Rebuild the underworld, one doomed soul at a time.
- Craft your own unholy arsenal of forbidden powers.
- Redefine what “eternal damnation” really means.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4128960/Hell_Architect_Survivors/
